definitions.explanation: The suppression or relief of pain. Most commonly appears as a modifier in compound words like 鎮痛剤 (painkiller) rather than standing alone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鎮痛剤|ちんつうざい}→鎮痛剤：15451_chintsuuzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
{歯痛|はいた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどくて→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧⟦{鎮痛薬|ちんつうやく}→鎮痛薬：21929_chintsuuyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手放|てばな}せない→手放す：05338_tebanasu⟧。
examples.english: My toothache is so bad that I can't do without pain medication.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鎮痛|ちんつう}⟦{作用|さよう}→作用：05761_sayou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{解熱|げねつ}→解熱：23429_genetsu⟧⟦{作用|さよう}→作用：05761_sayou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This medicine has both pain-relieving and fever-reducing effects.

notes:
Compound of {鎮|ちん} (to suppress) + {痛|つう} (pain). Most often used as a modifier in compounds rather than on its own.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{鎮痛剤|ちんつうざい}→鎮痛剤：15451_chintsuuzai⟧ (painkiller, analgesic)
- ⟦{鎮痛薬|ちんつうやく}→鎮痛薬：21929_chintsuuyaku⟧ (pain medication)
- {鎮痛|ちんつう}⟦{作用|さよう}→作用：05761_sayou⟧ (analgesic effect)
- {鎮痛|ちんつう}⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧ (pain-relieving effect)

USAGE:
In everyday speech, people more commonly say ⟦{痛|いた}み{止|ど}め→痛み止め：23497_itamidome⟧ for "painkiller." ⟦{鎮痛剤|ちんつうざい}→鎮痛剤：15451_chintsuuzai⟧ is the more formal or medical term.
